title: TC-EXT-02-INT-08: conn loses search_path after COMMIT — audit_entries query returns ServerError
symptom: TC-EXT-02-INT-08: queryRow fails with PgError.ServerError when querying audit_entries after prepareExt02Owner transaction commit
root_cause: Suspected: pool.Conn loses search_path after transaction COMMIT. If SET search_path was SET LOCAL (transaction-scoped), the connection reverts to DB default after COMMIT and audit_entries lookup hits public schema (42P01 relation does not exist). Needs further diagnosis.
acceptance_criteria: Audit entries for webhook_subscription.create/delete are queryable via pool.Conn after commit
notes: Pre-existing bug hidden by C42703 before ISS-0635 migration 1138 added the column.
